CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.draw_gacha_rarity(p_gacha_id text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select rarity
  from public.gacha_rarity_rates
  where gacha_id = p_gacha_id
  order by -ln(greatest(random(), 0.000000000001)) / weight
  limit 1
$function$
